properties.description: Overrides how Schema packages names translate to Java package names.
properties.name: packages

properties.description: The prefix of the Java package to generate.
properties.name: basePackage

properties.description: If set to "gradle" enables a generation of a basic set of Gradle build files.
properties.name: buildFiles

properties.description: If non-empty, specifies a list of Maven repositories that should be referenced by the generated package. This can be useful for specifying the locations of e.g. local or private dependencies.
properties.name: repositories

properties.description: Specifies Maven-style dependencies for the generated code.
properties.name: dependencies

properties.description: If non-empty and BuildFiles="gradle", enables the use of a given version of io.github.gradle-nexus.publish-plugin in the generated Gradle build files.
properties.name: gradleNexusPublishPluginVersion

properties.description: If non-empty and BuildFiles="gradle", generates a test section to enable `gradle test` command to run unit tests over the generated code. Supported values: "JUnitPlatform".
properties.name: gradleTest

properties.description: An override for the generated Java property name.
properties.name: name
